tweet.text: In May our Board of Directors launched a new Safety and Security committee to evaluate and further develop safety and security recommendations for OpenAI projects and operations. The committee includes leading cybersecurity expert, retired U.S. Army General Paul Nakasone. This review is underway and we’ll share more on the steps we’ll be taking after it concludes. https://openai.com/index/openai-board-forms-safety-and-security-committee/
